name: SXF AI Model Pricing & Specs Database
description: Canonical Standard API pricing and core specifications for selected frontier and specialist AI models tracked by SXF / AI.
pricing_scope: Provider-published Standard API pricing normalized to each model's explicit pricing_basis; unsupported pricing remains unavailable
calculator_excludes: Batch, Flex, Fast, Priority, or other non-Standard service tiers
Tool, grounding, search, code execution, and other add-on charges
Enterprise, volume, committed-use, or negotiated discounts

verification_policy.rule: Core factual fields must cite official provider sources. Paid token pricing is normalized only when the provider publishes a directly comparable Standard API rate; unsupported pricing remains explicitly unavailable.
verification_policy.unknown_policy: Use null, omit unsupported claims, or use an explicit provider-documented sentinel such as max_output='unlimited'; never infer a value. Missing official paid pricing must remain outside Standard calculator rates.

calculator_policy.rule: Only provider-published Standard paid token rates with generative input/output dimensions are calculator-eligible. Specialist meters and input-only embeddings remain visible but are excluded from token cost calculations.

taxonomy_policy.rule: Taxonomy fields are factual, provider-source-backed classification. Editorial recommendations do not belong in canonical capabilities.

pricing_unit_policy.token_compatibility: Existing token calculators only operate on pricing_basis.meter='tokens' and calculator_eligible=true.
pricing_unit_policy.specialist_rule: Non-token models use pricing.standard[].rates keyed by pricing_basis.dimensions. They must not be forced into input/output token fields.
pricing_unit_policy.display_rule: pricing_basis.display_unit is the human-readable unit label; pricing_basis.quantity is the denominator used for arithmetic.
